Prudent Corporate sees limited impact from new mutual fund rules but expects smaller players to face pressure, aiding consolidation.
The firm plans to expand geographically, focus on insurance growth, and targets mutual fund revenue growth of 20-22% by FY27.
Prabhudas Lilladher recommends accumulating Prudent Corporate Advisory Services with a target price of Rs 2875.
PRUDENT: AI Tools And New Dividend Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts now see fair value for Prudent Advisory Services at ₹3,300, up from ₹3,075. The change is tied to updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, the discount rate and a higher future P/E multiple.

news.title: Price target increased by 7.8% to ₹3,004
news.body: Up from ₹2,787, the current price target is an average from 7 analysts. New target price is 9.6% above last closing price of ₹2,740. Stock is up 12% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹66.78 for next year compared to ₹53.63 last year.

news.title: PRUDENT: Measured Outlook As AI Tools And Margins Support Steady Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have maintained the price target for Prudent Advisory Services at ₹3,075, reflecting a slightly lower discount rate and modest adjustments to revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E assumptions that support this unchanged outlook. What's in the News Prudent Corporate Advisory Services launched Edge+, an AI powered business management tool aimed at helping mutual fund distributor partners plan, service clients, market and manage growth with a single interface that focuses on growing business and saving time.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹53.63 (up from ₹47.25 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹13.4b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.22b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 17% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.7%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.9%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 48% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
